اعتذرا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَذَرَا (iʕtaḏarā) /iʕ.ta.ða.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اُعْتُذِرَا (uʕtuḏirā) /uʕ.tu.ði.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اِعْتَذِرَا (iʕtaḏirā) /iʕ.ta.ði.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
